Please first get approval for this feature in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions). The [progress documentation](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/progress.rst) describes extending `ProgressColumn` to build a custom column; `TaskProgressColumn(show_speed=True)` also displays iterations per second when the task total is unknown.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
